answer: Give each identity a meadow to tend: every public commitment plants work that only its own later follow-up can close, and unclosed commitments rot standing over a long horizon. A farm's copies share one operator's attention, so the more identities it spawns, the more plots go untended — the umber soil of neglected beds betrays the shared hands behind them. Standing rewards tended plots, not planted ones, so copies multiply exactly the upkeep their operator cannot pay.
